claims.text: 62 existing NLP datasets were converted into an instructional format
claims.reason: The paper states: 'We aggregate 62 text datasets that are publicly available on Tensorflow Datasets' (Section 2.1).

claims.text: Datasets were grouped into 12 task clusters
claims.reason: The paper states: 'each dataset is categorized into one of twelve task clusters' (Section 2.1).

claims.text: Up to 10 unique templates were created per dataset
claims.reason: The paper states: 'we manually compose ten unique templates that use natural language instructions to describe the task for that dataset' (Section 2.1).

claims.text: A 137B parameter pretrained language model (LaMDA-PT) was used as the base model
claims.reason: The paper states: 'we use LaMDA-PT, a dense left-to-right, decoder-only transformer language model of 137B parameters' (Section 2.4).

claims.text: FLAN surpasses zero-shot GPT-3 on 20 out of 25 evaluated datasets
claims.reason: The abstract and Section 3 both state: 'zero-shot FLAN outperforms zero-shot GPT-3 on 20 of 25 datasets that we evaluate'.

claims.text: Model scale ablation tested models of size 422M, 2B, 8B, 68B, and 137B parameters
claims.reason: Section 4.2 states: 'we evaluate the effect of instruction tuning on models of size 422M, 2B, 8B, 68B, and 137B parameters'.

claims.text: FLAN was compared against baselines including LaMDA-PT, GLaM, and 175B GPT-3
claims.reason: Section 3 explicitly compares against 'GPT-3 175B (Brown et al., 2020) and GLaM 64B/64E (Du et al., 2021)' in addition to LaMDA-PT.

claims.text: Increasing the number of templates per dataset had a negligible effect on performance
claims.reason: Appendix B.1 states: 'Using more templates per dataset, however, had a comparatively negligible effect on performance'.

claims.text: Instruction tuning is less effective for language modeling tasks such as commonsense reasoning and coreference resolution
claims.reason: Section 3 states: 'instruction tuning is less effective on tasks directly formulated as language modeling, where instructions would be largely redundant (e.g., commonsense reasoning and coreference resolution tasks)'.

claims.text: FLAN outperforms few-shot GPT-3 by a large margin on ANLI, RTE, BoolQ, AI2-ARC, OpenbookQA, and StoryCloze
claims.reason: The abstract explicitly states: 'FLAN even outperforms few-shot GPT-3 by a large margin on ANLI, RTE, BoolQ, AI2-ARC, OpenbookQA, and StoryCloze'.

claims.text: Instruction tuning uses less than 2% of the pretraining steps
claims.reason: The Environmental Considerations section states: 'The additional instruction tuning gradient-steps for finetuning FLAN is less than 2% of the number of pretraining steps'.

claims.text: TriviaQA is categorized as a Reading Comprehension dataset in this study
claims.reason: The paper categorizes TriviaQA under 'Closed-book QA' (Section 3, Figure 5, and Table 2 header 'CLOSED-BOOK QA'), not Reading Comprehension; the summary incorrectly lists it under Reading Comprehension.

claims.text: The authors performed n-gram matching to create 'clean' versions of datasets to mitigate data contamination from the pretraining corpus
claims.reason: Appendix C explicitly describes this procedure: 'for each benchmark, produces a clean version that removes all potentially leaked examples, defined as examples for which any n-gram (n varies per dataset but is roughly 13) overlapped with anything in the pretraining corpus'.
